LCB4 is synthesized in the cytosol, palmitoylated at the Golgi apparatus by AKR1, and then transported to the plasma membrane (PM) via the late Sec pathway. Most of the LCB4 is delivered further to the cortical ER (cER), which is closely adjacent to the PM. In stationary phase, G1 cell cycle arrest causes ER-localized LCB4 to be transported to the Golgi apparatus via the early Sec pathway, and finally to the vacuole via the MVB pathway, where it is degraded
